description: This file contains implementations of distributed synchronization barriers for checkpoint operations in a PyTorch distributed training environment. It defines an abstract Barrier class, concrete implementations using torch.distributed's barrier and TCPStore, and a registry for barrier types, facilitating coordinated checkpointing across multiple processes.

classes.name: Barrier
classes.description: Abstract base class for synchronization barriers, defining the interface for barrier implementations.

classes.name: DistBarrier
classes.description: Concrete barrier implementation using torch.distributed's built-in barrier method.

classes.name: TCPStoreBarrier
classes.description: Concrete barrier implementation using a TCPStore for synchronization, supporting barrier prefixing and sequence tracking.

methods.description: Decorator to register a barrier class in the global registry.

methods.description: Factory function to instantiate a barrier object based on a BarrierConfig.

methods.description: Method to perform the synchronization barrier operation.
